subject: Initial Stage-A v1 implementation
scope: First Stage-A construction
decision: Do not interpret as alpha failure; do not rerun as a candidate.
reopen_trigger: Historical archaeology requiring explicit defect reconstruction.

subject: Monotone rank/z/robust-z candidate variants
scope: C1/C2/C4 target-free selected Top-K structure
decision: Do not create new candidate IDs or spend another sweep on monotone transforms.
reopen_trigger: Non-monotone mechanism or new source changes the information set.

subject: Raw H-EXC-01 excursion asymmetry
scope: Exact raw previous-close excursion formula
decision: No post-hoc clipping, denominator floor, or rescue variant.
reopen_trigger: New pre-registered bounded semantics and denominator contract.

subject: H-LIQ-01 same-surface C2 residualization/persistence retry
scope: Same admitted OHLCV/value surface and C2 turnover-level residual
decision: No same-surface retry or C5 promotion.
reopen_trigger: New orthogonal source or non-redundant representation with admission path.

subject: Exact additive foreign-flow formulation
scope: Historical exact formulation already tested in prior program
decision: Do not rerun the exact formulation or generalize to the full family.
reopen_trigger: New source semantics, mechanism, or pre-registered formulation.

subject: Semantic margin interpretation
scope: Broker/margin snapshot interpretation
decision: Do not reinterpret a snapshot as historical financing flow or feature authority.
reopen_trigger: Proven field semantics, history, publication time, and population coverage.

subject: C3 YoY financial candidate under current bundle
scope: Financial quality/growth formula with current PIT bundle
decision: Do not fit, score, or promote a sparse subset.
reopen_trigger: Broader PIT financial bundle with period, knowledge-time, revision, and missingness policy.

subject: Repeated broad provider/source searches
scope: Zapi/IDX/TradingView/Investing/Stockbit and local source surfaces
decision: Do not retry solely to obtain a larger or nicer sample.
reopen_trigger: A new source artifact with row-level PIT/vintage/identity/CA/completeness semantics.

subject: Unresolved corporate-action rows as an excuse to repair/rescale prices
scope: 188-row basis residual and BBCA source disagreements
decision: Do not rescale, impute, infer events, or mutate canonical prices.
reopen_trigger: Population-complete event-to-window, issuer/ISIN, effective/knowledge-time, and basis contract.

subject: Eligibility population choice by convenience or chronology
scope: min_periods=60 versus minimum-20 conflict
decision: Do not choose the larger sample, code majority, or conservative-looking option.
reopen_trigger: Hash-bound authoritative policy record and authorized isolated regeneration.

subject: Protected historical predictive comparison
scope: H5/H10, IC/ICIR, OOS, PnL, incumbent comparison
decision: Do not open protected outcomes or indirectly reconstruct them.
reopen_trigger: Independent admission artifact proves population/PIT/identity/CA/revision/common support and authorizes one-shot evaluation.

subject: Creating C5 to show progress
scope: H-LIQ/H-VOL/H-EXC and combinations
decision: Keep hypotheses outside the protected candidate budget.
reopen_trigger: Non-redundant mechanism, explicit contract, and separately frozen candidate decision.

subject: Recreating historical alpha implementations solely because exact source is not in the active lane
scope: V3/V4/auxiliary historical families covered by archaeology, tombstones, and retained refs
decision: Use the durable family classification and latest PIT/integrity adjudication; do not revive old code without a new disputed claim or artifact.
reopen_trigger: A genuinely new historical source artifact, exact old implementation required to resolve a disputed classification, or authoritative adjudication change.

subject: Treating the hybrid firewall or packet PASS as a semantic protected-payload guarantee
scope: Disguised text/schema fields, unknown nested packet fields, and verifier-version freshness
decision: Keep the protected boundary closed and interpret PASS as scoped hash/path/denylist evidence only.
reopen_trigger: Separately reviewed semantic schema allowlist, independent formula challenger, or explicit verifier-version contract.

subject: Selecting minimum-20 or min-periods-60 from provenance alone
scope: Eligibility population for the new C1-C4 protocol
decision: Do not silently replace the current mask, choose the larger sample, or treat legacy 20-in-60 provenance as current authority without an explicit binding.
reopen_trigger: Hash-bound project policy decision followed by authorized isolated regeneration and full replay of structural controls.

subject: Treating C2 sign quadrants as an independent mechanism without a new interaction contract
scope: C2 ret_5 times log abnormal-turnover quadrant decomposition
decision: Retain the quadrant table as formula anatomy only; do not rerun it as a new mechanism or split C2 by the observed mixture.
reopen_trigger: A genuinely new C2 interaction representation or independently justified mechanism test.

subject: Treating public GitHub EOD ticker files or an IPO list as a population/PIT authority
scope: Pholenk IDX-Dataset, Dataset-Saham-IDX, and web-indonesia-ipo-data snapshots acquired in the public-source frontier
decision: Use these sources only for source discoverability, bounded gap explanation, and acquisition design. Do not backfill canonical data, replace the frozen panel, infer survivorship safety, or admit predictive research from them.
reopen_trigger: New source evidence with population-wide historical membership, issuer/ISIN lifecycle, row-level publication/knowledge time, CA basis, and revision semantics.

subject: Repeating the official current-directory snapshot to infer historical PIT population
scope: IDX GetCompanyProfiles current directory response independently cross-checked against the prior official current snapshot
decision: Use the current directory only for current identity/listing cross-checks and bounded acquisition design. Do not treat exact code agreement, current count, or listing dates as daily historical membership, survivorship, issuer/ISIN, revision, or CA authority.
reopen_trigger: A genuinely new population-wide daily PIT/lifecycle source contract with issuer/ISIN continuity, publication/knowledge time, revision/vintage semantics, and corporate-action basis linkage.

subject: Treating IDX NewsAnnouncement keyword results or linked documents as a complete PIT lifecycle authority
scope: Official GetAllAnnouncement keyword searches, publish timestamps, classification announcements, and linked attachments
decision: Use the endpoint only for bounded event discovery and publication-versus-effective timing audits. Do not infer complete historical coverage, daily membership, issuer/ISIN continuity, knowledge time, revision behavior, or corporate-action event-to-window linkage from keyword counts, publish dates, attachment URLs, or document-stated dates.
reopen_trigger: Complete official event archive with query/index completeness, effective and knowledge-time semantics, issuer/ISIN continuity, revision behavior, and population-wide linkage.

subject: Inferring an effective price-basis transition from an official stock-split announcement date or document
scope: BPII plan filings, PBID schedule-advertisement filing, RMKE correction filing, and unavailable linked attachment
decision: Keep plan, approval, advertisement, correction, event, and effective-transition dates separate. Do not rescale, repair, or admit historical prices from announcement dates or document-stated event dates without exchange-effective first-session and basis evidence.
reopen_trigger: Authoritative exchange-effective trading transition, first-session basis, issuer/ISIN linkage, knowledge time, revision lineage, and population-wide event-to-window evidence.

subject: Treating official IDX report, ratio, trading, issued-history, or current-profile routes as complete PIT authority
scope: Public www.idx.id report-index/XBRL, monthly ratio, per-security trading, issued-history, and current company-detail routes acquired in isolated staging
decision: Use these routes for raw coverage, source discovery, structural field/event audits, and contract design only. Do not promote report period, File_Modified, fsDate, row date, event date, listing date, official status, or code-universe breadth into historical available-at, population, issuer/ISIN, revision, effective-CA, capacity, or predictive admission authority.
reopen_trigger: A new authoritative contract that binds PIT membership, issuer/ISIN continuity, publication/knowledge time, revisions, exchange-effective CA basis, and relevant capacity semantics.

subject: Treating the official IDX raw crosswalk or XBRL projection as admitted PIT, canonical, or predictive input
scope: Official report/XBRL, quarterly report index, ratio snapshot, trading-history, issued-history, current-profile surfaces, and exact crosswalk against the current panel/V2 bundle
decision: Preserve raw surfaces and structural crosswalk as evidence-only. Do not substitute raw XBRL into the existing V2 bundle, treat ratio query month or fsDate as PIT time, infer effective CA transitions from raw dates, or treat exact trading-key overlap as canonical equivalence.
reopen_trigger: Population-wide PIT/identity/available-at/revision/CA contract, complete quarterly materialization with semantics, or explicit policy-authorized candidate admission.

subject: Treating CNTX panel absence, panel/anchor replay agreement, or a derived GitHub mirror as historical population authority
scope: CNTX zero panel rows versus 458 ACTIVE anchor rows, 1,581 official trading rows, and Pholenk derived mirror cross-check
decision: Use CNTX only as a bounded counterexample and security-identity case. Do not infer population completeness, survivorship safety, PIT eligibility, issuer continuity, or canonical equivalence from zero panel rows, exact key matches, or exact derived-mirror field matches.
reopen_trigger: Population-wide daily PIT membership with issuer/ISIN continuity, ticker-reuse handling, knowledge time, revision lineage, and explicit eligibility policy.

subject: Treating the 1,215-code observed union, KSEI current share table, or current IDX profiles as historical population/PIT authority
scope: Population-wide identity/lifecycle crosswalk and one-attempt KSEI detail acquisition in the isolated 2026-09-20 lane
decision: Use the source union and KSEI results for bounded identity, set-difference, lifecycle-residual, and counterexample research only. Do not infer that panel absence is security absence, that HTTP failure is identity absence, that current code/name/listing is historical continuity, or that observed-source coverage proves survivorship safety or daily PIT eligibility.
reopen_trigger: A versioned population-enumerating security/issuer/ISIN/series master with daily PIT, knowledge-time, revision, and exchange-effective lifecycle/CA semantics, or explicit owner policy.

subject: Treating public IPO participant/warrant codes or canceled offering identifiers as listed historical securities
scope: Retained public IPO CSV/JSON cross-check surface in the population identity lane
decision: Use only explicit issuer ticker_code fields or stock-file stems for normalized IPO membership. Preserve hyphenated canceled-offering identifiers separately; exclude participant and warrant codes from the security union. Do not promote the public IPO surface to authoritative listing/PIT identity.
reopen_trigger: A source contract that identifies issuer security codes, offering status, listing/effective date, security class, and issuer/ISIN continuity without mixed participant/warrant fields.

subject: Treating corporate-action document/event dates or issuer/name strings as effective security transitions
scope: Bounded official corporate-action sample and final identity-collision census in the population lane
decision: Preserve document/event semantics and repeated issuer/name mappings as typed evidence only. Do not infer an exchange-effective first session, price basis, legal continuity, ticker reuse, relisting, or series equivalence.
reopen_trigger: Exchange-effective CA/first-session evidence with security/ISIN linkage plus versioned issuer/series/ticker history and publication/knowledge-time semantics.

subject: Resolving lifecycle-conflict codes by interval precedence or bounded announcement absence
scope: BUKK, INRU, ITMA, KIAS, SKBM, and UNTX conflict audit across retained IDX current/delisting/security-master, issued-history, profile, KSEI, and announcement-search surfaces
decision: Keep each conflict class UNKNOWN or CONFLICTING. Do not select the current interval, delisting interval, event date, KSEI result, or announcement-search no-hit as the historical winner; the two SKBM hits are subsidiary-name notices only.
reopen_trigger: A distinct authoritative issuer/OJK/archive/KSEI-history source with security/ISIN linkage, complete event coverage, effective session, revision lineage, and population linkage.

subject: Treating zero exact announcement hits for historical delisting-only codes as event absence
scope: 115-code official-delisting-only residual class crosswalked against retained IDX announcement-search raw files
decision: Record 115 searched codes and zero exact hits as bounded query coverage only. Do not infer no announcement, no relisting, no issuer continuity, or no effective lifecycle transition.
reopen_trigger: A query-complete population-linked announcement/event source with security/ISIN identity, effective session, publication/knowledge time, corrections, and revision lineage.
